notes.title: Now on limited offer price to celebrate the update!
notes.content:
"Puzzle Battler! Mirai" is now on sale for a limited offer to celebrate the major update.
If you're interested, this is your chance to pick one up!

notes.title: Big updated to 1.10s!
notes.content:
Puzzle Battler! Mirai has been updated.

[Updates]
- Eased enemy HP to avoid prolonged battles.
- Supported Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).
- The strange English translation has been corrected in general.
- Other bug fixes.

notes.title: Update: April 25
notes.content:
The following bug fixes
- When the skill "Fire Child" hits an enemy, the application may becomes unstable.
- Skill "Fire Child" may hit background objects and go off.
